signal: Zone & Co launched Zoe, an agentic orchestration layer inside NetSuite, after a $76M growth investment from Insight Partners

email.subject1: a signal play for Zone & Co
email.body1:
Kenneth, saw Zone & Co launched Zoe, your agentic layer inside NetSuite, after the $76M Insight Partners raise.

Shipping a new platform usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the window closes, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Zone & Co off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kenneth, quick follow-up for Zone & Co.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zone & Co needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kenneth, last bit of proof for Zone & Co.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zone & Co's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kenneth, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching Zoe is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything after a raise.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Zone & Co either way.
